tool: OECD StatLink: PISA 2022 Results (Volume I), Annex B1, chapter 5 workbook
notes: Generated by `python -m etl.pisa_statlink`. Means and standard errors copied at full precision; 'm' (missing) cells are omitted, not filled. OECD = 'OECD average-23': OECD countries that can compare performance across all assessments, PISA 2000 to 2022. Mathematics trend table starts in 2003. Spain 2018 is 'm' in both tables (the OECD withheld Spain's 2018 reading results; the 2022 trend tables omit its 2018 mathematics too).
